name: easy_profiler
listed_description: Lightweight C++ instrumentation profiler library, listed as an alternative to Tracy.
reason: No comparison against any named profiler. README gives only absolute single-tool figures: about 15 ns average overhead per block (Intel Core i7-5930K 3.5GHz, Win7), 1-2% application slowdown, and 12 million blocks in under 300 MB (author-run, no compiler or flags, no baseline). Repo has no benchmark directory (dirs: easy_profiler_core, profiler_gui, reader, sample, scripts). Searches for third-party overhead comparisons with Tracy, Optick, Remotery or microprofile found none; Tracy's own FAQ and manual quote about 15 ns per zone and 8 ns per event for Tracy only, on different hardware, so the two cannot be paired. MIT or Apache-2.0, last commit 2026-08-05, 2.4k stars.

name: Optick
listed_description: Formerly Brofiler; super-lightweight C++ instrumentation profiler for games, listed as an alternative to Tracy.
reason: Claim is directional only ('super-lightweight'). README has no overhead figures; wiki home lists 9 pages (Optick API, Integration Guide, Autosampling, Event Tracing for Windows, UE4/UE5 plugins, etc.) and shows no numbers or comparisons (the other 8 pages failed to load, so their content is unchecked). No benchmark directory (dirs: gui, samples, src, tools). Searches found no third-party ns-per-event measurement of Optick; the only comparative statements found (search-result snippets of Tracy's own FAQ and manual) say Tracy's timer resolution beats Brofiler's (about 300 ns), which favours Tracy, not Optick. MIT licence, 3.2k stars, last commit 2022-07-07 (stale).
